substantive_insights: Participants moved from complaint to concrete rule proposals quickly, focusing on operational fixes (lids, extractor, wash, rota).

Cleaning responsibility was framed both as 'wash your own pans' and a specific rule that the cook washes their pan before leaving the kitchen.
